blocks.text: [Updated Oct. 20, 2026, 9:25 p.m.] MANILA, Philippines — Only one out of five of the subpoenaed hosts of the podcast ‘Machong Chismisan’ arrived at the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) in Pasay City on Tuesday. This appearance comes following a complaint against them over remarks that mocked Kris Aquino’s firstborn son Josh, who is on the autism spectrum. The NBI earlier sent subpoenas ‘Tito P,’ whose name is Tito Patrioto; Makoy Pare, also known as Showbiz Bro; Daniel Lawrence Vivar, also known as LV; RJ Carbonell and John Paulo Mojica.
